tmp:2397: tefillah as yirah / ma'amar ha-shalem — prayer identified as the aspect of fear/awe and as the 'complete utterance' (Bereishit = yarei boshet), linked to building Jerusalem/emunah
tmp:2399: keren ha-shofar — the horn of the shofar as symbol of the rebuker's voice, per 'Raise your voice like a shofar and tell My people their transgression' (Isaiah 58)
tmp:2400: hearing melody from a wicked musician — the act/state of listening to neginah played by a menagen rasha, which harms one's divine service
tmp:2401: difficulty in serving the Creator — the spiritual impairment (kasheh lo la'avodat haBorei) caused by hearing a wicked musician's melody
tmp:2402: 'tzarah ke-mavkirah' (Jeremiah 4:31) — verse-phrase 'anguish like a woman birthing her first', symbolizing difficult labor (kishui leileid) in the birth of the soul
tmp:2405: Rabbi Akiva — the Tannaitic sage who entered the Pardes in peace and exited in peace (Chagigah 14b), archetype of the tzaddik
tmp:2406: parsah — the hoof (of an animal), taken as the aspect of the foot/leg (regel)
tmp:2407: the feet of holiness enclothed in this world — raglei ha-kedushah, the lowest divine level ('the earth is My footstool') vested in physicality
tmp:2408: sheluchei ha-din — the emissaries/agents of judgment, called 'runners' (ratzim) in the Zohar, corresponding to the legs that grow heavy under harsh judgments
tmp:2409: bat zugo — a man's destined wife/soulmate, his nefesh-aspect and 'feet' (Zohar: 'the feet of His pious ones — this is the wife'), through whom his money comes
tmp:2411: hit'halekh ('Walk before Me', Genesis 17:1) — the verb of walking as the aspect of legs and of livelihood/money ('the substance at their feet')
tmp:2412: mochichei ha-dor — the rebukers of the generation, called 'feet' as limudei Hashem who counsel God and go on His mission to rebuke Israel; the outer seal
tmp:2413: kiymu ('they fulfilled', Shabbat 88a on Esther 9:27) — the word 'fulfilled' of Purim's re-acceptance of Torah, read as the aspect of the feet/legs
tmp:2414: raglin — legs/feet as the kabbalistic locus of birur ha-nitzotzot (clarifying sparks) until Mashiach, whose 'feet will stand on the Mount of Olives' (Zechariah 14:4)
tmp:2415: loving one another — the state of mutual love between souls/tzaddikim so strong it equals constantly seeing each other
tmp:2416: seeing one another — the state of constant mutual beholding that expresses and measures the strength of love between them
tmp:2418: dofek ('knocks', Song of Songs 5:2) — the beloved's knocking identified in Tikkunei Zohar as the aspect of ruach (spirit/pulse) that reveals the illumination of the hands
tmp:2419: panav — the face, specifically the nose ('the recognition of their faces' = the nose, Yevamot 120a), as the seat of the ruach/breath blown into the nostrils
tmp:2420: ruach dil'tata — the 'lower spirit' of the paired upper/lower spirits, corresponding to po'al (actualization) as against potential, formed by sweetening fierce anger
tmp:2422: ruach tzefonit — the north wind that never blew in the wilderness (Yevamot 72a), representing the holy spirit of life (ruach chaim dikedushah)
tmp:2424: speaking between oneself and one's Maker — private hitbodedut speech to God, defined as an aspect of ruach ha-kodesh, from which David founded the Psalms
tmp:2426: arba tzitzit — the four fringes of the garment as the spirit of life from 'the four winds' (Ezekiel 37:9), subduing the storm-wind of the opponents
tmp:2427: sighing over a lack and extending one's breath — the act of the anachah as arichat ha-neshimah/erekh apayim that draws the ruach-chaim to fill the deficiency
tmp:2428: makif — the encompassing/surrounding light (the tallit), identified with the spirit of life, 'round and round goes the wind' (Ecclesiastes 1:6)
tmp:2429: the melody of David's harp — the niggun of the kinnor of David played by the north wind, embodying the spirit of life in the tzitzit-corners
tmp:2430: the vitality of a given thing — the chiyut sustaining each particular thing, located in its ruach; where a lack occurs, the lack is in this vitality
tmp:2431: the spirit-of-life of a given thing — the particular ruach-chaim that sustains each thing, the true locus of any deficiency in it
tmp:2432: nekudot tovot — the good points still within a person, equated with the good spirit (ruach tovah) to be gathered out of the evil spirit in hitbodedut
tmp:2434: romach — the lance/spear, expounded as ruach + mem (spirit + the forty/worlds), in the Rabbah bar bar Chanah tale of the Arab riding under the raised knee
tmp:2435: the spirit from the four winds (Ezekiel 37:9) — the ruach gathered from arba ruchot, embodied in the four-cornered tallit and the Thirteen Attributes
tmp:2437: ruach nishbarah ('a broken spirit', Psalms 51:19) — the broken spirit of a contrite heart, identified as the true olah-offering ('the sacrifices of God')
tmp:2439: sin'ah — hatred as a middah, identified as ruach ra'ah / turbulent air (Judges 9:23 with Rashi) that prevents speech from being heard
tmp:2440: shiga'on — madness, the spirit of folly (ruach shtut) that enters a person, driven out by subduing the evil inclination
tmp:2441: all the tzaddikim of the generation — the collective of generation's righteous, each one a shepherd (ro'eh) containing an aspect of Moshe and making a Mishkan
tmp:2445: panekha ('Your face', Psalms 30:8) — God's face as the aspect of mercy/compassion, whose hiding (hastarat panim) characterizes exile
tmp:2446: rachamim va-chasadim — mercy and lovingkindnesses as the quality of gadlut ha-mochin (expanded consciousness), 'da'at set between two divine Names' where El = chesed
tmp:2448: rachamim stam of Ze'ir Anpin — plain/ordinary bounded mercy of the configuration Ze'ir Anpin, all humans can arouse, which must itself pray to awaken the great mercy
tmp:2451: ri"v din — the number 216 spelling 'din' (judgment), the gevurah-aspect of the veins (veridin/mantzpakh letters)
tmp:2452: reisha — the head (Aramaic), in the Zoharic dictum 'and this menorah is the head', the seat of the brain/mochin
tmp:2453: rinah — joyous song as a term for prayer ('to hear the rinah', I Kings 8:28), the heart's joy enabling the mountains/tzaddikim to sing
